# Soul Tether

[![build](https://github.com/TheWarior73/soultether/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/TheWarior73/soultether/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-26.2-lightyellow?logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://fabricmc.net)

**Made With** ![love](https://img.shields.io/badge/❤️Love-pink?style=flat-square)

Transports your inventory somewhere safe on death

</center></div>

## Usage

Craft a `Soul Tether` and a `Soul Chest`, place the chest down and right click it with the tether.  
Now, if you happen to encounter a devastating bug that somehow completely drained your little red bar... Most of your stuff will be saved !

## Features

- Multi-tier Soul Tethers
    - Basic
    - Iron
    - Gold
    - Diamond
- Soul Chest block that holds onto your items

## Compatibility
- Compatible with Mod Menu and it's configuration screen.

## Misc Information

This mod was partially developed using AI. I (the developer) have made this choice for the following reasons :
- Never Made a Minecraft mod in my life prior to this. I needed help to get kickstarted
- Getting a base to work on, even if bad (Usually bad btw. Fuck AI)

### I have a few things to say regarding the usage of AI in this project.

I believe to have put substantial amounts of work on this project, regardless of any Agent being used.  
All code generated by an AI has been thoroughly reviewed and patched over as the goal was for it to provide a base to overwrite right after

I am proud of the idea that I bring to the table with this project, and the AI was a mere tool like others to assist in kickstarting and learning new concepts proper to minecraft mod developement.

In the end, if you do not want to engage with this project due to AI usage, it is totally okay.
I won't blame you for this at all. I do not plan on using AI this much in my life, and hopefully the bases I got from this first mod was enough to not need to use AI later down the line...
